answer: Deposits are visible in velvet, and mesa reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 44% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 138 aliases, and each one needs its own funded knoll account. A farm of 3275 identities would post 3920 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
